landing.dilemma.label: The Forwarder's Express Quote Dilemma
landing.dilemma.title: Respond first, price carefully, and still protect the relationship.
landing.dilemma.body: Network partners need to answer quickly without exposing buying rates, missing FSC/FX updates, or sending inconsistent customer quotes.
landing.dilemma.point1: Respond too slowly and the shipment goes to another forwarder.
landing.dilemma.point2: Quote too fast and margin, FSC, or accessorials can be missed.
landing.dilemma.point3: Share raw carrier costs and partner relationships become exposed.
landing.dilemma.point4: BridgeLogis keeps the express quote workflow fast, itemized, and controlled.
landing.workflow.label: How BridgeLogis Works
landing.workflow.title: From shipment details to customer-ready quote in one controlled flow.
landing.workflow.body: Use BridgeLogis as a branded quote desk for express courier inquiries, not just a calculator.
landing.workflow.step1: Enter route, destination ZIP, delivery mode, and cargo dimensions.
landing.workflow.step2: Compare verified express carrier cost structures with FSC and FX.
landing.workflow.step3: Review packing, pickup, handling, and carrier add-ons before quoting.
landing.workflow.step4: Apply partner margin decisions and export a customer-ready quote.
landing.workflow.step5: Save history so follow-ups and re-quotes stay consistent.
landing.trust.margin.title: Protect Your Margin
landing.trust.margin.body: Position BridgeLogis around controlled quote output: carrier cost, partner markup, and customer quote stay commercially disciplined.
landing.trust.brand.title: Quote Under Your Brand
landing.trust.brand.body: Help overseas agents and forwarding partners answer customers quickly while presenting a consistent partner-facing quote desk.
landing.trust.network.title: Built for Network Partners
landing.trust.network.body: Designed for WCA, MPL, EAN, JCtrans-style freight networks that need Korea-origin express execution and transparent surcharge logic.
